headline: 7+ Day Charters for 6+ Guests
primaryText:
The Leeward Islands change character from one stop to the next: Antigua's countless bays, the quiet harbour at Gustavia in St. Barts, the calmer volcanic shores of Nevis and St. Kitts. A week here can move through several of them, with time to stay an extra night wherever one asks you to.

We built this itinerary around six or more guests aboard a crewed motor yacht, sailing yacht or catamaran, 60ft and above. We ask for a minimum of seven days because that's what it takes to feel the difference between these islands, and a full crew because it lets you spend the week enjoying the Caribbean rather than sailing it yourselves.

If a week through the Leeward Islands, done properly, is what you're after, we'd like to help you plan it.

A soft deadline about 2027 dates adds gentle urgency for a high-consideration purchase, and the ad has been running since July, which suggests it is performing.

headline: A Week Without the Noise
primaryText:
The loudest thing all week was the anchor chain. 🌊

Seven days island-hopping the Adriatic, mooring in coves the ferries don't reach and the crowds never find.
whyItWorks: The opening line sets up a quiet, specific scene, so the reader wants to know what kind of week has an anchor chain as its loudest sound. It sells escape and exclusivity, with places most tourists never reach, instead of listing boat specs. The vertical aerial video of a yacht on calm blue water backs up that feeling, and the 2027 dates give a soft reason to start planning now.

headline: Accessible Luxury in Croatia
primaryText:
Discerning travelers, rejoice! 🌊
Escape to Croatia's 1,200 pristine islands and indulge in Michelin-level cuisine at a fraction of the cost. Unbeatable rates on luxury yachts - up to 40% less than Italy.
Experience unparalleled luxury without overspending. Smart travel has never felt so indulgent. #LuxuryTravel
whyItWorks: It opens by addressing a self-image (discerning travelers), then pairs a premium aspiration with a concrete price comparison against a well-known rival destination. The image repeats the 40% claim as overlay text, so the value message lands even if the body copy is skipped. It has been running for about four months, which suggests it is performing well enough to keep funded.

headline: Croatia's Islands on a Private Gulet
primaryText: Your gulet, your route, your adventure. Escape the crowds and discover Croatia’s coastline in total privacy and comfort.
whyItWorks: A striking aerial photo of a wooden sailing yacht in clear water sells the dream at a glance, and the overlay text names the product right away. The copy speaks to people tired of crowded holiday spots by promising privacy and control over the trip. Three short benefit callouts on the image answer the usual questions about uniqueness, crowds and price. Being a live ad that has run for months suggests it holds up.

headline: Gulet. Not gullet.
primaryText:
One letter separates a very good boy's afternoon from your best holiday yet.

A gulet is a traditional wooden vessel chartered for the Adriatic — your own crew, your own route, a new bay every morning.
Spend your time with family, friends or colleagues on an unforgettable maritime adventure.

All you need to do is pick your dates and your vessel.
We do the rest.
whyItWorks: A pun on two near-identical words (gulet vs gullet, a dog's chew stick) sets up a small puzzle that makes people stop and smile. The side-by-side picture of sticks and a boat explains the joke at a glance, and it gently teaches what a gulet is. The ad has been live for several months, which suggests the playful tone is earning its keep.

primaryText:
Want to have the most unique experience in Croatia and spend a week aboard a traditional gulet? Sounds fantastic — but don’t wait too long!
The best gulets are booking out fast for 2026. Inquire today and explore Croatia in style on your own private, fully crewed gulet.
headline: Explore Croatia in Style
whyItWorks: It opens by asking whether the reader wants a one-of-a-kind trip, then uses scarcity about the best boats selling out to push an early enquiry. The footage of friends laughing and sharing food on deck lets the viewer picture themselves on the trip. The soft call to inquire fits a high-value purchase that needs a conversation before booking.

headline: Jetzt ist die beste Zeit, für 2027 zu buchen
primaryText:
Planen Sie bereits Ihren Yachturlaub 2027? Dann ist jetzt der richtige Zeitpunkt zu buchen. ⛵

Profitieren Sie von einer größeren Auswahl an Yachten und Katamaranen, sichern Sie sich Ihre Wunschtermine und sparen Sie mit unseren Frühbucherangeboten bis zu 35 %.

Die beliebtesten Sommerwochen bleiben nicht lange verfügbar. 🌊
description: Tailor-made yacht charters in Croatia designed for luxury, privacy, and unforgettable experiences.
whyItWorks: Opens with a planning question that self-selects people already thinking about next summer, then turns early booking into a fear of missing the best yachts and weeks. The 'up to 35%' early-bird saving is repeated on the image, so the offer lands even without reading the text. Brand new (started 8 Oct 2026, <100 impressions), so no longevity signal yet.
